schema.text: Do you use the car to make sure someone does not have to come home alone by public transport at night?

ar.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: هل تستخدم السيارة من أجل ضمان ألا يضطر شخص إلى العودة إلى البيت وحده بوسائل النقل العام ليلًا؟

de.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: Nutzen Sie das Auto, damit jemand nachts nicht allein mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln nach Hause fahren muss?

en.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: Do you use the car to make sure someone does not have to come home alone by public transport at night?

fa.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: آیا از خودرو استفاده می‌کنید تا مطمئن شوید کسی شب مجبور نیست تنها با حمل‌ونقل عمومی به خانه برگردد؟

fr.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: Utilisez-vous la voiture pour que personne n’ait à rentrer seul dans les transports en commun la nuit ?

hu.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: Használja az autót annak biztosítására, hogy valakinek ne kelljen éjszaka egyedül hazamennie tömegközlekedéssel?

it.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: Usi l’auto per far sì che nessuno debba tornare a casa da solo sui mezzi pubblici di notte?

tr.#Do you use the car to make sure someone: Birinin geceleri toplu taşımayla eve yalnız dönmek zorunda kalmaması için arabayı kullanıyor musunuz?
